annotations.text:
Compact density.
Consumer-fintech air would make a 354-row list unusable — rows here are 56px, still above the 44px target.

Red discipline.
224 of 354 SKUs are out of stock — that is the resting state, so it reads grey. Red marks the 9 selling items down to 1-2 units, and one action per screen.

Unknown is designed, not blank.
Cost is missing on all 354 rows. The dashed chip says so out loud instead of printing a fake zero.
